listing.name: Dedicated Repair Equipment & Improvised Refinery | v0.0.1
listing.summary: 2 small mods that add their respective hullmods.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a built-in hullmod for the Salvage Rig that speeds up repairs on one other ship while reducing supply costs and draining metals.

description: This hullmod is built into the Salvage Rig and cannot be installed elsewhere. It increases repair speed for a single target ship within the fleet, though it does not affect CR recovery speed. While active, it reduces the cost of recovery supplies but drains metals proportional to that cost.
